decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The windows along the Prebend Gardens frontage shall remain fixed shut at all times
Condition : 4 - The sliding panels in the Chiswick High Road elevation shall be closed from 7.00 p.m. and not open again until 8.00 a.m. the following morning.

Condition : 5 - Before the relevant part of the development is commenced, a scheme to ensure that the lightingto the shop front fascia does not shine upwards to the windows of the flats above shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with these details.
Condition : 6 - The main entrance door and the fire door proposed on the Chiswick High Road elevation shall be self-closing.
Condition : 7 - The disabled access arrangements shall be as shown on drawing No. 10520/20A received 1.11.05.
description: Installation of a new shop front and side incorporating internal alterations to bar
